text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over the past day, with Ethereum's 2.4% decline slightly outpacing Bitcoin's 2.1%, suggesting mild profit-taking across the majors despite their still-dominant market positions. The Fear & Greed index at 64 (Greed) with a 7-day decline of 10 points indicates sentiment is cooling from recent highs, though buyers haven't panicked yet. Bitcoin dominance holding steady above 58% paired with $105B in daily volume suggests the market is consolidating rather than capitulating, with no severe rotation away from the largest assets.
